decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 08.00 to 18.00 on Mondays to Friday and 08.00 to 13.00 on Saturday and none shall take place on Sundays and public holidays without prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority
Condition : 4 - The access doorway to the proposed shop front shall have a minimum clear opening width of 1800mm and shall remain level within the pavement.

Condition : 5 - The use shall not commence until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The proposed W/C as shown on plan 042-TUR-008 (A) located on the ground floor of the premises shall remain available for customer use.
description: Demolition of the existing ground floor rear additions. The creation of a basement for storage with WC's. The erection of a single storey rear extension. The replacement of rear access stair and landing area on 2nd floor to give access to maisonettes above 2nd floor.  Internal alterations to the existing maisonettes to increase the number of bed rooms.  Installation of air conditioning condensers at first floor level adjacent to 48 Turnham Green. Installation of a new shop front with sliding doors.
